description: Final response every artifact-producing agent must return. The Control Center writes each artifact to its path, after checking the path is one of the stage's declared outputs.

summary.description: Two or three sentences for the human.

artifacts.description: One entry per output file of the stage.

path.description: Workspace-relative path, exactly as listed in the contract outputs.

blockers.description: Concrete, actionable blockers. Empty on PASS.
